source: Items and acceptance text copied unchanged from loop/backlog.json on branch neural-node-loop (PR #1); depends_on added for the swarm.

items.title: Deterministic event IDs and an injectable clock
items.acceptance: Event IDs and recorded timestamps come from an injectable ID source and clock. Two appends in the same clock tick get distinct IDs, and a duplicate event ID is rejected by both the JSONL and SQLite backends instead of being stored.

items.title: Replayable runtime runs
items.acceptance: A relay run with injected IDs and clock can be replayed from its episodic log and reproduces a byte-identical event stream. A log that was modified after the run is detected as not replaying.

items.title: Validate trusted memory on read
items.acceptance: MemoryStore validates every stored record against the memory-event contract and re-runs the node-output verifier when reading. A tampered record, or one carrying a side channel such as notes, fails closed and is never returned as trusted.

items.title: Schemas available to installed builds
items.acceptance: A built, non-editable install can verify node outputs without a source checkout. Any schema copies shipped in the package are byte-identical to schemas/, enforced by a test.

items.title: A task-specific deterministic verifier
items.acceptance: A narrow task with known ground truth and a deterministic task-specific verifier, so a relay can be judged as having achieved its objective rather than only being well-formed. Includes negative controls where well-formed but wrong outputs are rejected.

items.title: Evidence-gated inheritance in the real runtime
items.acceptance: Successors in the real Orchestrator read durable state only through the evidence-gated promotion boundary. The regional poisoning scenario runs through that runtime path with clean, poisoned and corrupted-evidence controls, reporting abstentions alongside contamination.

items.title: Multi-hop contamination and matched-cost comparison
items.acceptance: Contamination injected several successor generations deep is measured, and promotion is compared with evidence-gated shared memory at matched check cost. Results report abstentions and state what the comparison does not show.
